audience: Shopify merchants who sell subscriptions with Awtomic

useCases.title: Find subscriptions with failed billing
useCases.text: The AI lists subscriptions with status and next billing date, and reads each one's billing attempts with SUCCESS or FAILURE, error code and message.

useCases.title: Review a customer's subscriptions and payment details
useCases.text: The AI reads a customer's subscriptions with next billing dates, saved addresses and payment methods on file (type, brand, last digits, expiry).

useCases.title: Check your selling plan groups
useCases.text: The AI lists the selling plan groups with their options and whether they are prepaid, and opens one for its plans and products.

useCases.title: Pause, reactivate or cancel a subscription
useCases.text: The AI pauses a subscription so it is not billed or shipped, reactivates a paused one or a cancelled one that was not prepaid, or cancels a customer's subscription.

useCases.title: Skip an order or change the billing date or frequency
useCases.text: The AI skips the next order and can undo the skip, sets the next billing date, or changes how often a subscription is billed.

useCases.title: Charge an order now or ask for a new payment method
useCases.text: The AI bills the saved payment method and creates the next order at once, or has Shopify email the customer a link to update their payment method.
